senses.sense_definition: The star-shaped symbol (*), used in printing and writing to refer a reader to a note, indicate an omission, or mark a footnote.

examples.text: Please check the note at the bottom of the page marked with an <w>asterisk</w>.
The author used an <w>asterisk</w> to hide the sensitive letters of the word.

senses.sense_definition: A qualification, condition, or blemish attached to an otherwise outstanding achievement or record.

examples.text: Many critics felt that the championship victory came with an <w>asterisk</w> because key opponents were injured.
His impressive home run record will always carry an <w>asterisk</w> in the eyes of baseball fans.

senses.sense_definition: An object or pattern resembling or shaped like a star-shaped typographic mark.

examples.text: Use a small knife to cut an <w>asterisk</w> in the cardboard lid.
A tiny <w>asterisk</w> was embroidered onto the front pocket of her shirt.

senses.sense_definition: A small star or something resembling a star.

examples.text: In older poetry, a distant light was often praised as an <w>asterisk</w> shining brightly.
He sought to shine as an <w>asterisk</w> rather than live in obscurity.

senses.sense_definition: A person or thing considered marginal or of little lasting significance.

examples.text: He feared his long political career would be reduced to an <w>asterisk</w> in future history books.
The short-lived tech startup proved to be merely an <w>asterisk</w> in the industry's history.

senses.sense_definition: A liturgical utensil with radiating arms placed over the paten to keep the veil from touching the Eucharistic bread, used especially in Eastern churches.

examples.text: The deacon carefully placed the golden <w>asterisk</w> over the diskos before adding the veil.
In the Byzantine rite, an <w>asterisk</w> protects the holy bread during the service.

senses.sense_definition: To mark or annotate printed matter or writing with an asterisk symbol.

examples.text: The editor decided to <w>asterisk</w> each unfamiliar term that needed explanation.
She spent the afternoon reading the report and <w>asterisking</w> the critical figures.
